node.title: Re^2: Avoiding escaped child elements with HTML::TreeBuilder::XPath or HTML::Element
node.author: mldvx4
node.doctext: Thanks haukex and marto. In this case, I just want to trim the unnecessary white space from the start and end of a few elements and attributes. The attributes are easy to work with so that is solved. However, I am not sure how to apply a substitution, s///, to an element containing more that just text.
